expected_invariant: A target-scoped name proposal must preserve the target person's arrival-time question and must not replace it with the neighboring file-transfer action.

minimal_reproducers.expected_fact: Li is asked at what time they can arrive; passing a file is not the target action.

related_controls.expected_meaning: Teacher Wang is asked their arrival time; no instruction to close a window.
Li is asked when they will leave; do not change departure to arrival or file transfer.

negative_controls.expected_meaning: Ask the addressed person's arrival time; no target-name proposal may activate from neighboring names.
